prompts.prompt: Wide shot of an autumn wine tasting inside Folii wine bar in Stockholm, golden natural light filtering through tall windows, a long rustic table laden with dozens of wine bottles, cheese boards with French cheeses, and twenty guests standing in small groups swirling glasses and conversing warmly.

Medium shot of a sommelier in a dark apron pouring red wine for a smiling couple at Le Bistrot de Wasahof in Stockholm, warm stage-light from overhead pendants, French cheeses and crusty bread arranged on the marble counter, intimate bistro atmosphere with soft bokeh background.

Environment view of the elegant Vinterträdgården ballroom at Grand Hotel Stockholm during an Italian wine tasting, soft natural daylight streaming through arched windows, rows of wooden tables draped in white linen, hundreds of wine glasses catching the light, guests browsing Italian import tables.

Close-up detail of three crystal wine glasses on a slate board, filled with deep ruby Bordeaux wines, beside wedges of aged French cheeses and fig jam, a hand reaching to lift one glass, warm tungsten stage lighting, shallow depth of field on a wooden Wasahof bistro table.

Intimate eye-level shot of two friends clinking wine glasses at Folii bar, soft natural autumn light from a nearby window illuminating their joyful expressions, a shared cheese board with French cheeses between them, candid moment of laughter, blurred Stockholm street visible behind them.
